I kept headings direct, paragraphs short and labels specific so the English remains simple and easy to scan. On mobile, campaign cards, donation choices and calls to action keep the same priority. Supporting information stays close to the programme it explains. This gives Hasene a focused project story that reflects the real nonprofit work, shows the decisions built into the page structure and avoids generic claims about design or business results.
